name: Check PBT Coverage After Task
description: Reminds to check property-based test coverage after completing a spec task

then.prompt: A spec task was just completed. Check if there are any property-based tests (fast-check) that should be added or updated based on the changes made. Reference the correctness properties in .kiro/specs/horde-battle-game/design.md and verify the task's acceptance criteria are covered by tests.
